answer: Time-staked seniority resists sybils: a new agent must lock a small deposit and complete verifiable work for a maturing period before earning full rewards, like a walnut tree that yields timber only after years of growth. Rewards vest gradually, and a violet badge of tenure cannot be transferred or bought. An attacker spinning up thousands of fresh identities pays the waiting cost on every one while earning almost nothing, so flooding the economy becomes slow, expensive, and easy to spot.
